[{"name":"p_next_order_reorder","idea":"Item-level chance that a buyer's next order contains the product again (smoothed), plus the median days between consecutive purchases of the product by the same user, over the last 90 days.","level":"item","sql":"WITH op AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, order_id, product_id, ts FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY), ou AS (SELECT order_id, lead(order_id) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS next_order FROM orders WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY), rr AS (SELECT op.product_id, count(*) AS n_all, count(n2.order_id) AS n_hit FROM op JOIN ou ON op.order_id = ou.order_id LEFT JOIN op n2 ON n2.order_id = ou.next_order AND n2.product_id = op.product_id WHERE ou.next_order IS NOT NULL GROUP BY op.product_id), gg AS (SELECT product_id, median(gap_d) AS med_gap FROM (SELECT product_id, epoch(ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id ORDER BY ts, order_id)) / 86400.0 AS gap_d FROM op) g WHERE gap_d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id) SELECT rr.product_id, (rr.n_hit + 1.0) / (rr.n_all + 10.0) AS ag_p_next_reorder, gg.med_gap AS ag_p_med_regap FROM rr LEFT JOIN gg ON rr.product_id = gg.product_id"},
{"name":"up_category_choice","idea":"Share of the user's orders in the product's category (last 120 days) that picked this product, plus the number of the user's orders since the product was last bought.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), ul AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.product_id, l.master_category_id FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id), uo AS (SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.ts DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id), pc AS (SELECT product_id, max(master_category_id) AS cat FROM (SELECT product_id, master_category_id FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY UNION ALL SELECT product_id, master_category_id FROM ul) x WHERE master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), upo AS (SELECT ul.user_id, ul.product_id, count(DISTINCT ul.order_id) AS n_ord, min(uo.rn) AS best_rn FROM ul JOIN uo ON ul.order_id = uo.order_id GROUP BY ul.user_id, ul.product_id), ucat AS (SELECT user_id, master_category_id AS cat, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_cat FROM ul WHERE master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id, master_category_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, CASE WHEN uc.n_cat IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE least(1.0, COALESCE(upo.n_ord, 0) * 1.0 / uc.n_cat) END AS ag_up_cat_choice, upo.best_rn - 1 AS ag_up_orders_since FROM cand c LEFT JOIN upo ON upo.user_id = c.user_id AND upo.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN ucat uc ON uc.user_id = c.user_id AND uc.cat = pc.cat"},
{"name":"user_brand_affinity","idea":"Share of the user's orders (last 120 days) containing the product's brand and days since the user last bought that brand, covering candidates the user never bought.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), ul AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.product_id, l.brand_name, l.ts FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id), pb AS (SELECT product_id, max(brand_name) AS brand FROM (SELECT product_id, brand_name FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY UNION ALL SELECT product_id, brand_name FROM ul) x WHERE brand_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), un AS (SELECT user_id, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_u FROM ul GROUP BY user_id), ub AS (SELECT user_id, brand_name, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_b, max(ts) AS last_ts FROM ul WHERE brand_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id, brand_name) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, CASE WHEN pb.brand IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(ub.n_b, 0) * 1.0 / un.n_u END AS ag_ub_share, epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ub.last_ts) / 86400.0 AS ag_ub_days_since FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pb ON pb.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN un ON un.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN ub ON ub.user_id = c.user_id AND ub.brand_name = pb.brand"},
{"name":"user_repeat_fraction","idea":"How habitual the user is: mean share of products in each order (after the first in the 120-day window) that the user had already bought earlier in the window, plus the same share for the latest order.","level":"user","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), op AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.product_id, l.ts FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id), r AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, ts, CASE WHEN row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS rep FROM op), po AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, avg(rep) AS rep_frac, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY min(ts), order_id) AS k FROM r GROUP BY user_id, order_id) SELECT user_id, avg(rep_frac) AS ag_u_repeat_frac, arg_max(rep_frac, k) AS ag_u_last_repeat_frac FROM po WHERE k > 1 GROUP BY user_id"},
{"name":"p_new_buyer_share","idea":"Smoothed share of the product's buyers in the last 28 days who had not bought it earlier in the 120-day window, separating trial-driven products from staples.","level":"item","sql":"WITH b AS (SELECT product_id, user_id, min(ts) AS first_ts, max(ts) AS last_ts FROM lines GROUP BY product_id, user_id) SELECT product_id, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY) + 1.0) / (count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY) + 2.0) AS ag_p_new_buyer_share FROM b GROUP BY product_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY) > 0"}]
